accepted_slice: A killed product worker's durable operation lease can be recovered and completed by a replacement worker process. A prior worker attempt that resumes after a replacement claim is fenced before its next checked side effect.

environment.frontend: Node v25.9.0, npm 11.12.1; local Vite production bundle built

procedure_and_result.action: Run the stale-attempt regression before implementation. Expire the original worker lease, recover and re-claim the operation, then release the original worker and observe whether it publishes its next checked side effect.
procedure_and_result.observed: The original attempt published after the replacement claim.

procedure_and_result.action: Fence each worker cancellation/deadline check by the attempt_count returned by its durable claim.
procedure_and_result.observed: A stale worker raises the existing cancellation path before its next checked side effect; its guarded terminal update cannot change the replacement attempt's RUNNING state.

procedure_and_result.action: Start execute_operation in a separate Python process on a synthetic rescore-only operation, kill the process after it enters the operation, expire the durable lease, run recover_expired, and start a replacement worker process.
procedure_and_result.observed: The killed process left a durable RUNNING operation; recovery returned it to QUEUED and the replacement process completed it. The test used a temporary local SQLite database and no external requests.

procedure_and_result.action: Run worker lifecycle, operation concurrency, and two affected connected-browser acceptance tests on the final source candidate.
Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'` on source commit d516834ac3bd48352ef3aa8885a1de1fffe53419 with the local web bundle present.
procedure_and_result.observed: 851 tests passed; one optional PostgreSQL test skipped because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset; duration 485.840 seconds.

procedure_and_result.action: Run `npm ci` and `npm run build` in apps/web, repository agent-skills/catalogue/progress validators, Python compileall on changed modules, lane coordination validation, and `git diff --check`.
procedure_and_result.observed: Frontend production build and repository validators passed. npm reported the existing Vitest engine range does not include Node 25.9.0; the build completed successfully.

limitations: MJ-REQ-008 remains PARTIAL and issue #9 remains OPEN. This slice does not prove physical host restart, browser-process crash recovery, or every product worker operation type.
The test makes the lease expired immediately after killing the synthetic worker instead of waiting for the configured lease interval.
Live PostgreSQL runtime was NOT_RUN because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset; the single optional PostgreSQL test was skipped.
Hosted Actions and hosted review are NOT_RUN under the current local-only policy.
